findings: persist only writes if destination does not already exist, then unconditionally inserts newdata in ThumbnailDataCache. Instance imageThumbnailData repair calls samepersist under identicalkey; native reproduction proves repaired image is not persisted over corrupt file. Static imageThumbnailData(sourceURL:modifiedAt:thumbnailURL:) has different explicit overwrite path; not conflated.
Original tests cover absent thumbnail repair, diskload/missing file, explicit stale pruning, size/clear and single directoryindex load. None covers corrupt-existing instance repair.

Thumbnail key hashes standardized sourcepath plus exact modificationtime string; no content digest or size in key. standardizedFileURL is lexical path normalization, not guaranteed physical symlinkcanonicalization despite comment. No restored-mtime/symlinkcollisions control here.

Index locks are per ThumbnailStore instance; directory loaded once, caches can differ across independent instances/external edits. Memory cache generation prevents pre-clear load from repopulating after clearAll. These source mechanisms are not exhaustive concurrency proof.
